manifest.title_fil: Magkasundo sa aksyon at suriin ang resulta
objectives_fil: Bumuo ng action plan na may responsable, kumpirmadong resources, petsa, follow-up at panukat na susuriin kasama ang residente.
objectives_en: Create an action plan with an owner, confirmed resources, dates, follow-up and a measure to review with residents.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kailangan ng plano at panukat ng resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: An action plan and result measure are needed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Punan ang action plan ng grupo. Magdagdag ng panukat sa napapanahong balita at tugon kapag may hindi nakatapos.
sections.takeaway_en: Complete the group’s action plan. Add a timely-update measure and a response to an unfinished commitment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ginagawang malinaw at masusuri ang napagkasunduan.
sections.takeaway_en: This makes the agreement specific and reviewable.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang kulang sa “Magpapabalita ang grupo balang araw”?
check.prompt_en: What is missing from “The group will send updates someday”?

options.fil: Listahan ng personal na kondisyon ng lahat ng residente.
options.en: A list of every resident’s personal health conditions.

options.fil: Pangakong may sasakyan kahit hindi pa ito naitatanong.
options.en: A promise of transport even though nobody has confirmed it.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi kailangan ang ganitong detalye para sa plano ng paanyaya. 2: Nagdadagdag ito ng hindi kumpirmadong pangako. 3: Ginagawang malinaw at masusuri ang napagkasunduan.
check.feedback_en: 1: These details are unnecessary for an invitation plan. 2: This adds an unconfirmed promise. 3: This makes the agreement specific and reviewable.

sections.takeaway_fil: May gawain, responsable, kumpirmasyon ng resources, petsa, panukat at magalang na follow-up kasama ang komunidad.
sections.takeaway_en: Includes an action, owner, resource confirmation, date, measure and respectful community follow-up.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pinananatili ang pananagutan habang inaayos ang aktuwal na problema.
sections.takeaway_en: This maintains accountability while addressing the actual problem.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi naihatid ang ilang paanyaya. Ano ang gagawin sa follow-up?
check.prompt_en: Some invitations were not delivered. What should happen at follow-up?

options.fil: Alamin ang hadlang at baguhin ang plano.
options.en: Discuss the barrier and adjust the plan.

options.fil: Ipahiya sa pulong ang kasaping hindi nakatapos ng gawain.
options.en: Shame the member who did not finish in the meeting.

options.fil: Sabihing matagumpay pa rin dahil marami ang dumalo noon.
options.en: Declare success because many people attended the earlier meeting.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Pinananatili ang pananagutan habang inaayos ang aktuwal na problema. 2: Maaaring masira ang tiwala at hindi matukoy ang dahilan. 3: Hindi patunay ng nakarating na balita ang dami ng dumalo sa pulong.
check.feedback_en: 1: This maintains accountability while addressing the actual problem. 2: This can damage trust without clarifying the reason. 3: Meeting attendance does not prove that updates reached people.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.

assets.alt_en: Three boxes: Act, Follow up, Review together.

assets.caption_en: Includes an action, owner, resource confirmation, date, measure and respectful community follow-up.
